actions.action: Move plant a metre back from window or behind sheer curtain
Check soil moisture with finger 3 cm deep
Water thoroughly when top 3 cm is dry
Pull gently on black leaves to check for rot
Remove mushy or black leaves at base
If crown rotten, root a plantlet cutting in water
Use filtered or rested water if tap water is hard
Trim brown tips with clean scissors

reason: The answer blames too much sun when the confirmed cause was too little light, and its main advice to move the plant further from light is the opposite of the fix (moving it outside), so it would worsen the plant.
